title: Expectations-Based Capital Inflow Shocks
title_zh: 基于预期的资本流入冲击
title_primary: 基于预期的资本流入冲击
title_secondary: Expectations-Based Capital Inflow Shocks
authors: Jongrim Ha, Dohan Kim, M. Ayhan Kose, Francis Warnock
official: 官方在线 2026-09-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Identifying the impact of capital inflows on output is challenging because inflows are forward-looking and respond to expectations about future economic conditions. We develop a new measure of capital inflow shocks using a simple and broadly applicable expectations-based framework that isolates the unexpected component of inflows by purging movements predicted by professional forecasters’ expectations. Estimates using the new measure for 27 emerging market economies indicate that capital inflows have sizable expansionary effects on output, operating through stronger domestic consumption and investment and easier financing conditions. Additional analysis indicates that equity-type inflows generate greater and more persistent effects than debt-type inflows, while large inflow reversals result in more pronounced effects than comparable increases in inflows. These results are robust to a wide range of alternative specifications.
abstract_zh: 识别资本流入对产出的影响具有挑战性，因为资本流入具有前瞻性，并会对未来经济状况的预期作出反应。我们使用一个简单且广泛适用的基于预期的框架，构建了一种新的资本流入冲击度量，通过剔除专业预测者预期所预测的变动，分离出资本流入中未预期的成分。使用这一新度量对27个新兴市场经济体进行的估计表明，资本流入对产出具有相当大的扩张效应，其作用通过更强的国内消费和投资以及更宽松的融资条件实现。进一步分析表明，股权型流入比债务型流入产生更大且更持久的效应，而大规模流入逆转所产生的影响比可比规模的流入增加更为显著。这些结果在多种替代设定下均保持稳健。

title: Does monetary policy affect automation, growth, and welfare in a Schumpeterian model? Chu et al. (2023) vs. Jones and Liu (2024)
title_zh: 货币政策是否影响熊彼特模型中的自动化、增长与福利？Chu等（2023）与Jones和Liu（2024）之比较
title_primary: 货币政策是否影响熊彼特模型中的自动化、增长与福利？Chu等（2023）与Jones和Liu（2024）之比较
title_secondary: Does monetary policy affect automation, growth, and welfare in a Schumpeterian model? Chu et al. (2023) vs. Jones and Liu (2024)
authors: Qichun He, Xin Yang, Heng-fu Zou
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Given the growing literature on automation, it is important to examine the effects of monetary policy on automation, growth and welfare. Using cross-country panel data, we find a significant negative effect of the nominal interest rate on automation. To rationalize this stylized fact, we introduce money via cash-in-advance (CIA) constraints on consumption, production, automation, and vertical innovation into the framework of Chu et al. (2023). We also compare the results with those from a competing automation model developed by Jones and Liu (2024). Based on Chu et al. (2023), the relative strength of cash constraints on automation and vertical innovation is critical. If the CIA constraint is stronger (weaker) for automation, a higher nominal interest rate increases (decreases) the allocation of high-skilled labor to vertical innovation. Consequently, the level of automation declines (rises), while vertical innovation, as well as aggregate economic growth, accelerates (slows). Calibrating the model to the US economy, we find that the cash constraint on automation is stronger. Quantitative results show that higher nominal interest rates reduce automation but promote growth. They also increase the welfare of different households and aggregate welfare. Depending on parameter values, monetary policy in Jones and Liu (2024) can also generate predictions qualitatively consistent with our empirical findings. Both models predict that a higher nominal interest rate reduces the capital share, consistent with our cross-country regression. Overall, our study highlights the importance of automation in the conduct of monetary policy.

title: Daddy’s Girl: Daughters, Managerial Decisions, and Gender Inequality
title_zh: 父亲的女儿：女儿、管理决策与性别不平等

authors: Maddalena Ronchi and Nina Smith
official: 官方在线 2026-08-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using Danish registry data, we study how managers’ gender attitudes shape gender inequality in the workplace by exploiting the birth of a daughter - as opposed to a son - as a plausibly exogenous shock to male managers’ gender attitudes. Comparing within-firm changes in women’s labor outcomes depending on the gender of the manager’s newborn child, we find that women’s relative earnings and employment increase by 4.4% and 2.9% respectively following the birth of the manager’s first daughter.
abstract_zh: 利用丹麦登记数据，我们通过利用经理生育女儿（相对于儿子）作为对男性经理性别态度的一种看似外生的冲击，研究经理的性别态度如何塑造职场中的性别不平等。通过比较企业内部女性劳动成果的变化，依据经理新生儿性别，我们发现，在经理生育第一个女儿后，女性的相对收入和就业率分别增加了4.4%和2.9%。

official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The share of young Australians reporting poor mental health has risen sharply over the past two decades, a pattern mirrored across many high-income countries. A central question is whether this reflects a genuine deterioration in underlying mental health or shifts in how different birth cohorts report their symptoms. Using 22 years of nationally representative longitudinal survey data from Australia (2002-2023), we construct a predicted mental health index from respondents
abstract_zh: 过去二十年间，澳大利亚年轻人报告心理健康状况不佳的比例急剧上升，这一趋势在许多高收入国家中同样显现。核心问题在于，这是否反映了潜在心理健康的真实恶化，还是不同出生队列报告症状方式的转变。利用澳大利亚2002年至2023年间22年的全国代表性纵向调查数据，我们构建了一个基于受访者预测的心理健康指数。

title: Cycles of Infertility: Intergenerational Transmission and the Role of Assisted Reproduction
title_zh: 不孕不育的循环：代际传递与辅助生殖的作用
title_primary: 不孕不育的循环：代际传递与辅助生殖的作用
title_secondary: Cycles of Infertility: Intergenerational Transmission and the Role of Assisted Reproduction
authors: Viktoria Falk, Andreas Madestam, Emilia Simeonova
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This study examines the persistence of fertility-related health problems across generations within the same family, and the utilization of assisted reproductive technologies (ART). Using comprehensive Swedish registry data, we document significant intergenerational transmission of fertility difficulties for both daughters and sons, independent of parental socioeconomic status. Daughters whose parents reported such problems are 2.6 percentage points, or 19.4 percent, more likely to experience fertility problems themselves. Sons whose parents reported fertility difficulties experience a 1.7 percentage point, or 13.5 percent, increase. These associations persist across alternative measures and samples. Comparing biological and adopted children raised in the same households, we find that this phenomenon is unlikely to be driven by family awareness of fertility issues, pointing to biological and other factors that biological children share with their parents but adopted children do not. Medical technology works equally well for those who use it, and we find no significant association between the success of advanced fertility treatments and parental backgrounds. However, past generations’ fertility difficulties are associated both with higher medical expenses and with social costs such as increased likelihood of divorce.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了同一家族内生育健康问题在代际间的持续性，以及辅助生殖技术（ART）的利用情况。利用瑞典全面的登记数据，我们记录了生育困难在女儿和儿子中的显著代际传递现象，这一现象与父母的社会经济地位无关。父母报告有此类问题的女儿，其自身遭遇生育问题的可能性高出2.6个百分点，即19.4%；而父母报告有生育困难的儿子，其风险则增加1.7个百分点，即13.5%。这些关联在不同衡量指标和样本中均保持一致。通过比较在同一家庭环境中成长的亲生子女与收养子女，我们发现这一现象不太可能由家庭对生育问题的认知所驱动，而是指向了亲生子女与父母共享而收养子女不具备的生物学及其他因素。医疗技术对使用者的效果相当，我们未发现先进生育治疗的成功率与父母背景之间存在显著关联。然而，过去几代人的生育困难不仅与更高的医疗费用相关，还与离婚可能性增加等社会成本相关联。

title: The Extreme Points of Mean-Preserving Contractions
title_zh: 均值保持压缩的极值点
title_primary: 均值保持压缩的极值点
title_secondary: The Extreme Points of Mean-Preserving Contractions
authors: Andreas Kleiner, Benny Moldovanu, Philipp Strack, Mark Withmeyer
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study multidimensional mean-preserving contractions (MPC) and their extreme and exposed points. Proposition 1 focuses on extreme MPCs of a measure μ. Necessarily, each finitely supported extreme MPC ν induces a partition of X, the domain of μ, in convex sets such that the support of ν on each element of the partition is an affinely independent set, and such that the restriction of ν on each element of the partition is itself a MPC of the restriction of the prior μ on that element. Proposition 2 connects finitely supported Lipschitz-exposed points (measures that are unique optimizers of Lipschitz-continuous objectives) and power diagrams, which are divisions of a space into convex polyhedral cells according to a weighted proximity criterion. Power diagrams are very useful in a number of economic applications such as optimal transport and mechanism design. Finally, we apply the above results to several questions concerning moment persuasion and categorization
abstract_zh: 我们研究了多维均值保持压缩（MPC）及其极值点与暴露点。命题1聚焦于测度μ的极值MPC。必然地，每个有限支撑的极值MPC ν在μ的定义域X上诱导出一个由凸集构成的分割，使得ν在每个分割元素上的支撑集是仿射独立的集合，并且ν在每个分割元素上的限制本身是该元素上先验测度μ限制的MPC。命题2将有限支撑的Lipschitz暴露点（即Lipschitz连续目标函数的唯一优化者所对应的测度）与幂图联系起来，幂图是根据加权邻近准则将空间划分为凸多面体单元的结构。幂图在诸多经济应用中极为有用，如最优运输和机制设计。最后，我们将上述结果应用于关于矩说服和分类的几个问题。

title: Identifying the Causal Impacts of International Sanctions on Agricultural Trade: An Event Study Approach
title_zh: 识别国际制裁对农产品贸易的因果影响：一项事件研究法分析
title_primary: 识别国际制裁对农产品贸易的因果影响：一项事件研究法分析
title_secondary: Identifying the Causal Impacts of International Sanctions on Agricultural Trade: An Event Study Approach
authors: Junyan Tian
official: 官方在线 2026-08-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: International sanctions have been increasingly deployed for political and economic reasons. While the consequences of sanctions on political and macro‐economic outcomes are well‐analysed, rigorous evaluations of the causal impacts of sanctions on the agriculture and food (agri‐food) trade remain limited. We obtain the causal estimates of sanctions' impact on agri‐food trade by utilising samples that have been threatened with but not subject to sanctions to construct the counterfactual of the sanctioned sample. Exploiting an event study approach to analyse data from 154 countries over the period 1960–2016, we find that international sanctions mostly resulted in modest and short‐lived declines in the total agri‐food trade of sanctioned countries as opposed to the counterpart of countries under sanction threats. Trade volumes declined substantially for beef, pork, roots, dairy and fruit products. The decline in the exports of agri‐food commodities resulting from international sanctions was more significant relative to the drop in imports. The study also reveals that the impact of sanctions on agri‐food trade depends partially on the type of the sanction and on the sanction imposer. While the differences in the impact of sanctions across agri‐food commodities largely reflect the fact that the commodities where there are stronger impacts are those produced more in countries subject to sanctions, future studies incorporating analytical tools from industrial organisation may provide more nuanced insights on why and how the trade of differential agri‐food commodities was impacted by sanctions so differently.
abstract_zh: 国际制裁日益频繁地被用于政治和经济目的。尽管制裁对政治和宏观经济结果的影响已被充分分析，但关于制裁对农业与食品（农食）贸易因果影响的严谨评估仍然有限。我们通过利用曾受到制裁威胁但未实际遭受制裁的样本，构建受制裁样本的反事实，从而获得制裁对农食贸易影响的因果估计。采用事件研究方法分析1960年至2016年间154个国家的数据，我们发现，与受到制裁威胁的国家相比，国际制裁大多导致受制裁国家农食总贸易量出现温和且短暂的下降。牛肉、猪肉、根茎类作物、乳制品和水果产品的贸易量显著减少。由国际制裁导致的农食商品出口下降相较于进口下降更为显著。研究还揭示，制裁对农食贸易的影响部分取决于制裁类型及实施制裁的主体。尽管不同农食商品间制裁影响的差异在很大程度上反映了受影响较大的商品正是受制裁国家生产较多的商品，但未来结合产业组织分析工具的研究可能为解释不同农食商品贸易为何及如何受到制裁如此不同的影响提供更为细致的见解。

title: Reserves and the Buyer of Last Resort
title_zh: 储备与最后买家
title_primary: 储备与最后买家
title_secondary: Reserves and the Buyer of Last Resort
authors: Frederic Boissay, Harald Uhlig
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine the role of central bank reserves and public liquidity when secondary markets may freeze. Central bank reserves help intermediaries purchase assets during stress but crowd out investment. Under laissez-faire, intermediaries hold insufficient reserves, overlooking how aggregate liquidity reduces freeze risk. We propose a "market-backstop principle", akin to Bagehot’s principle for intermediaries. It combines state-contingent buyer-of-last-resort interventions to restore trading with modest liquidity requirements to limit moral hazard. The welfare benefits of restoring market functioning exceed the fiscal costs of interventions. We explore implications for the size and composition of central bank balance sheets.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了当二级市场可能冻结时，中央银行储备和公共流动性的作用。中央银行储备有助于中介机构在压力时期购买资产，但会挤出投资。在自由放任政策下，中介机构持有的储备不足，忽视了总体流动性如何降低冻结风险。我们提出了一项“市场最后支持原则”，类似于针对中介机构的巴杰特原则。该原则结合了视状态而定的最后买家干预措施以恢复交易，并辅以适度的流动性要求以限制道德风险。恢复市场运作的福利收益超过了干预的财政成本。我们探讨了这对中央银行资产负债表规模和构成的启示。

title: Technological empowerment: the governance effect of bank artificial intelligence adoption on corporate shadow banking
title_zh: 技术赋能：银行人工智能应用对企业影子银行的治理效应
title_primary: 技术赋能：银行人工智能应用对企业影子银行的治理效应
title_secondary: Technological empowerment: the governance effect of bank artificial intelligence adoption on corporate shadow banking
authors: Huangying Gu, Hao Ding, Jinhai Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using loan-level matched data between banks and firms from 2014 to 2022, we examine the association between banks’ adoption of artificial intelligence and shadow banking activities among non-financial firms. We find that bank-level AI adoption is associated with a significant and robust reduction in firms’ engagement in shadow banking. This mitigating effect operates through two channels. First, AI adoption enhances banks’ ex-ante screening capacity, improves borrower identification, expands credit access for high-quality firms, and alleviates financing constraints. Second, by strengthening post-lending monitoring, AI adoption is associated with a lower incidence of corporate financial misconduct and limits firms’ ability to divert loan proceeds into shadow banking activities. The governance effect is more pronounced among firms with greater information asymmetry and in regions with weaker financial regulation, and it is strongest for entrusted loans, a major form of corporate shadow banking in China. Further evidence shows that bank AI adoption is associated with reduced firms’ reliance on short-term borrowing and significantly higher investment in core business activities, suggesting that AI curbs financial arbitrage incentives and facilitates the reallocation of credit towards the real economy. This study provides novel bank–firm-level evidence on how digital financial intermediation reshapes corporate shadow banking behaviour. KEYWORDS: Bank AI adoption corporate shadow banking financial intermediary functions credit availability financial misconduct JEL CLASSIFICATION: G21 G28 G32
abstract_zh: 基于2014至2022年银行与企业层面的贷款匹配数据，本文考察了银行采用人工智能与非金融企业影子银行活动之间的关联。研究发现，银行层面的人工智能采用与企业影子银行参与度显著且稳健地降低相关。这一抑制作用通过两条渠道实现：其一，人工智能采用增强了银行的事前筛选能力，改善了借款人识别，扩大了优质企业的信贷获取渠道，并缓解了融资约束；其二，通过强化贷后监控，人工智能采用与企业财务违规行为发生率降低相关联，并限制了企业将贷款资金转移至影子银行活动的能力。这种治理效应在信息不对称程度较高的企业以及金融监管较弱的地区更为显著，且对委托贷款（中国公司影子银行的主要形式）的影响最为突出。进一步证据表明，银行人工智能采用与企业短期借款依赖度降低及核心业务投资显著增加相关，这表明人工智能抑制了金融套利动机，并促进了信贷向实体经济的重新配置。本研究为数字金融中介如何重塑企业影子银行行为提供了新颖的银行-企业层面证据。关键词：银行人工智能采用；企业影子银行；金融中介功能；信贷可得性；财务违规行为 JEL分类：G21 G28 G32

title: Allocating faculty compute budgets
title_zh: 分配教师计算预算
title_primary: 分配教师计算预算
title_secondary: Allocating faculty compute budgets
authors: Joshua S. Gans
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A classic exchange between Tullock (1973: 1256–1257.")) and Parks (1975: 225–226. https://doi.org/10.1086/260317 .")) debated whether universities should concentrate research support on senior or junior faculty. Both made their arguments informally. We formalise the two positions and then ask which conclusions survive when the scarce input is AI compute rather than secretarial help. Under complementary inputs, aggregate-output maximisation favours juniors, while minimum-output objectives favour seniors. With AI modelled as a more substitutable input, greater substitutability alone does not reverse the junior-favouring allocation when faculty differ only in career incentives. Only the perfect substitutes limit removes the junior advantage by making the department indifferent. Reversal requires that senior faculty also possess a human-capital advantage. Sufficiently high substitutability can then shift the allocation towards seniors. A two-period extension shows why the dynamic case for juniors depends on additional primitives such as longer career horizons or steeper AI learning curves. Two appendices establish that neither the two-researcher representation nor quadratic effort costs drives the central invariance result.
abstract_zh: Tullock（1973: 1256–1257）与Parks（1975: 225–226）之间的一场经典辩论，探讨了大学是否应将研究支持集中于资深教师或青年教师。双方均以非正式方式提出论点。我们将其两种立场形式化，并考察当稀缺投入从秘书协助转变为人工智能算力时，哪些结论依然成立。在互补性投入条件下，总产出最大化倾向于支持青年教师，而最低产出目标则倾向于资深教师。当人工智能被建模为更具替代性的投入时，若教师仅存在职业激励差异，则更高的替代性本身并不会逆转偏向青年教师的资源配置。只有在完全替代的极限情形下，部门才会因无差异而消除青年教师的优势。逆转需要资深教师同时拥有人力资本优势，此时足够高的替代性才能使资源配置向资深教师倾斜。两期扩展模型揭示了为何动态情形下支持青年教师的结论依赖于额外前提条件，例如更长的职业周期或更陡峭的人工智能学习曲线。两个附录证明，无论是双研究者表征还是二次努力成本，均不驱动核心不变性结果。

title: Retirement Policy in a Post-Covid World
title_zh: 后疫情时代的退休政策
title_primary: 后疫情时代的退休政策
title_secondary: Retirement Policy in a Post-Covid World
authors: Arapakis, Karolos, French, Eric
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In this paper we evaluate the challenges of funding retirement in the aftermath of the Covid pandemic. We first show that the pandemic had only modest effects on life expectancy and employment. These effects were small relative to longer term trends. Nevertheless, they worsened pension funding problems, highlighting the need for future pension reforms. Next, we highlight key evidence on how labor supply responds to pension reforms. Evidence suggests that incentivising later retirement can reduce pension deficits.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了新冠疫情后退休资金筹措面临的挑战。我们首先指出，疫情对预期寿命和就业的影响相对有限，这些影响相较于长期趋势而言较小。然而，它们加剧了养老金资金问题，凸显了未来养老金改革的必要性。接着，我们重点展示了劳动力供给如何响应养老金改革的关键证据。证据表明，激励延迟退休有助于减少养老金赤字。

title: Reply to “Comment on “Development Effects of Electrification: Evidence from the Topographic Placement of Hydropower Plants in Brazil”
title_zh: 回复“关于《电气化的发展效应：来自巴西水电站地形选址的证据》的评论
title_primary: 回复“关于《电气化的发展效应：来自巴西水电站地形选址的证据》的评论
title_secondary: Reply to “Comment on “Development Effects of Electrification: Evidence from the Topographic Placement of Hydropower Plants in Brazil”
authors: Lipscomb, Molly, Mobarak, Ahmed Mushfiq, Barham, Tania, Szerman, Dimitri
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We update the results of Lipscomb et al 2013 to improve the stability of the instrument, to reconcile differences in definitions of the Amazon used in controls, and to update the standard errors based on the Lee et al 2022 tF procedure. We show that the instrument remains strong in the revised specification. The impact of electricity access is positive and important in magnitude though smaller and less precisely estimated than originally estimated in Lipscomb et al 2013.
abstract_zh: 我们更新了Lipscomb等人（2013）的研究结果，以提升工具变量的稳定性，协调控制变量中亚马逊定义差异，并基于Lee等人（2022）的tF程序更新标准误。研究表明，在修订后的设定中，工具变量依然有效。电力接入的影响在量级上显著为正，但相较于Lipscomb等人（2013）的原始估计，其影响更小且估计精度较低。

title: Gender identity and power imbalance in a group contest
title_zh: 群体竞赛中的性别认同与权力失衡
title_primary: 群体竞赛中的性别认同与权力失衡
title_secondary: Gender identity and power imbalance in a group contest
authors: Defne Mia Aktas, Florian Heine
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Many high-stakes organisational decisions are made by committees, where members exert costly influence to shape a single collective outcome. When committees are gender-imbalanced, the salience of gender identity may affect who mobilises influence and how numerical power translates into effective decision weight. We study how gender-identity salience interacts with numerical power in a controlled laboratory setting using a group-contest design. We vary the numerical balance of power (Female-Majority vs. Male-Majority) and manipulate whether gender composition is revealed. We find larger, advantaged groups invest significantly more and identity salience has asymmetric effects by gender. Among minority men facing female-majority groups, making gender salient increases investment and their initial disadvantage shrinks over time. Among minority women facing male-majority groups, investment does not increase and their relative disadvantage grows over time. These divergent responses are not explained by general social preferences or in-group cohesion. The findings suggest highlighting gender identity may intensify mobilisation by minority men without similarly empowering minority women, with implications for the design of diversity and transparency policies.
abstract_zh: 许多高风险的组织决策由委员会作出，其中成员投入高昂的影响力以塑造单一的集体结果。当委员会性别失衡时，性别身份的显著性可能影响谁动员影响力，以及数字上的权力如何转化为有效的决策权重。我们通过一个群体竞赛设计，在受控实验室环境中研究性别身份显著性与数字权力的相互作用。我们变化权力的数字平衡（女性占多数与男性占多数），并操纵性别构成是否被揭示。我们发现，规模较大且占优势的群体投资显著更多，且身份显著性对性别的影响具有不对称性。在面临女性占多数群体的少数男性中，使性别显著会增加投资，其初始劣势随时间缩小。在面临男性占多数群体的少数女性中，投资并未增加，其相对劣势随时间扩大。这些不同的反应无法由一般社会偏好或群体内聚力解释。研究结果表明，强调性别身份可能加剧少数男性的动员，而不会同样增强少数女性的力量，这对多样性和透明度政策的设计具有启示意义。

title: From field trials to farm adoption: identifying the productivity effect of on-farm technology adoption
title_zh: 从田间试验到农场采纳：识别农场技术采纳的生产率效应
title_primary: 从田间试验到农场采纳：识别农场技术采纳的生产率效应
title_secondary: From field trials to farm adoption: identifying the productivity effect of on-farm technology adoption
authors: Kristiina Ala-Kokko, Jesse B. Tack, Jisang Yu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Technology adoption is an important farm management decision and is frequently made using information that is unavailable to the researcher. Aside from their own experiences, producers often rely on extension services to inform their adoption decisions. Here, we propose a novel instrumental variable (IV) approach to identify the effect that a new technology, genetically modified (GM) corn, has on farm yield using instruments constructed from extension information. The proposed approach allows us to explore the degree to which endogeneity bias is present in the GM adoption effect on farm productivity. Candidate instruments are constructed from variety trial data to resemble information acquired by producers from university extension variety trial reports and are spatially merged with on-farm production data. We find that failure to account for the endogeneity of the adoption decision does indeed result in an upward bias in the estimated productivity gains. After correcting for this bias through our IV approach, GM corn results in large on-farm yield gains of 19.6 bushels per acre. We demonstrate that variety trial data can be used to estimate the on-farm impact of new technology, and this approach is general enough to be applied to additional contexts (i.e., technologies, crops, and/or locations).
abstract_zh: 技术采纳是农场管理中的一项重要决策，且通常基于研究者无法获取的信息进行。除自身经验外，生产者常依赖推广服务来指导其采纳决策。本文提出一种新的工具变量（IV）方法，利用推广信息构建的工具变量，识别转基因玉米这一新技术对农场产量的影响。该方法使我们能够探究转基因采纳效应中内生性偏差对农场生产率影响的程度。候选工具变量基于品种试验数据构建，以模拟生产者从大学推广品种试验报告中获取的信息，并与农场生产数据进行空间匹配。研究发现，若未考虑采纳决策的内生性，确实会导致估计的生产率提升出现向上偏差。通过IV方法纠正这一偏差后，转基因玉米使农场产量实现每英亩19.6蒲式耳的大幅提升。我们证明，品种试验数据可用于估算新技术对农场的影响，且该方法具有足够普适性，可应用于其他情境（如不同技术、作物或地区）。

title: The effect of the Kansas tax reform on self-employment hours worked
title_zh: 堪萨斯州税制改革对自雇工时的影响
title_primary: 堪萨斯州税制改革对自雇工时的影响
title_secondary: The effect of the Kansas tax reform on self-employment hours worked
authors: Ege Can, Ke Lyu, Hieu Pham, Jingjing Yang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In 2012, Kansas exempted pass-through business income from the state individual income tax. We examine the reform’s causal effect on entrepreneurial labor supply using a difference-in-differences design with Current Population Survey and American Community Survey microdata, modeling selection into self-employment with a Heckman selection model. The reform reduced weekly hours among the self-employed in the short run, with the response concentrated among the unincorporated self-employed, the group most directly exposed to the exemption. In our preferred selection-corrected estimates, the reform reduced annual labor supply among unincorporated self-employed workers by roughly 19 to 89 hours, depending on the dataset. The effect attenuates and does not persist. These findings suggest that the Kansas reform did not increase entrepreneurial effort on the intensive margin, despite its stated goal of promoting business activity.
abstract_zh: 2012年，堪萨斯州将穿透型企业收入从州个人所得税中豁免。我们利用当前人口调查和美国社区调查的微观数据，采用双重差分法并结合赫克曼选择模型对自雇就业的选择进行建模，考察了该改革对创业劳动供给的因果效应。改革短期内减少了自雇者的每周工作时间，且这一反应主要集中在直接受豁免影响的非公司制自雇群体中。在我们偏好的经选择校正的估计中，改革使非公司制自雇工人的年劳动供给减少了约19至89小时，具体取决于所使用的数据集。该效应随时间减弱且未持续存在。这些发现表明，尽管堪萨斯州改革旨在促进商业活动，但并未在集约边际上增加创业努力。这是订阅内容的预览，请通过机构登录以查看访问权限。

title: Housing Supply Elasticities: A Structural Vector Autoregression Approach
title_zh: 住房供给弹性：结构向量自回归方法
title_primary: 住房供给弹性：结构向量自回归方法
title_secondary: Housing Supply Elasticities: A Structural Vector Autoregression Approach
authors: Wesley A. Miller, Anthony W. Orlando, Christian L. Redfearn
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We estimate the first time‐varying, county‐level index of housing supply elasticities across the United States, using a structural vector autoregression model with sign restrictions to identify the effect of a positive demand shock. This index reveals four features of the supply curve in different local housing markets. First, supply elasticities are low, on average, generating faster price growth than housing unit growth for most of the country. Second, there is significant variation in elasticities across counties, both urban and rural. Third, elasticities have declined in more counties than they have risen over time, particularly in large urban markets. Fourth, these new estimates predict housing quantity growth better than previous models in the literature.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们利用带有符号约束的结构向量自回归模型识别正向需求冲击效应，首次估算了美国各县级住房供给弹性的时变指数。该指数揭示了不同地方住房市场供给曲线的四个特征：第一，平均而言供给弹性较低，导致全国大部分地区房价增速快于住房单元增速；第二，城乡各县之间的弹性存在显著差异；第三，随时间推移，弹性下降的县数量多于上升的县，尤其是在大型城市市场；第四，相较于文献中的既有模型，这些新估计值能更准确地预测住房数量增长。

title: New U.S. Business Establishments: Surging or Stalling?
title_zh: 美国新设企业：激增还是停滞？
title_primary: 美国新设企业：激增还是停滞？
title_secondary: New U.S. Business Establishments: Surging or Stalling?
authors: Dan Cao, Henry Hyatt, Toshihiko Mukoyama, Erick Sager
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Since the 1990s, the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) has reported much more rapid growth in U.S. private sector employer establishments than has the Census Bureau – the gap reached roughly 1.6 million by 2023. Using linked BLS-Census microdata, we document two main drivers. First, a large and growing number of employers providing services to the elderly and persons with disabilities are in scope for the BLS frame but not the Census Bureau’s. Second, many firms appear with substantially more establishments in the BLS frame. These discrepancies substantially affect the measured establishment size distribution and quantitative policy analysis.
abstract_zh: 自20世纪90年代以来，美国劳工统计局（BLS）报告的私营部门雇主机构数量增速远超人口普查局——截至2023年，两者差距已达约160万家。通过关联BLS与人口普查局的微观数据，我们揭示了两大驱动因素：其一，为老年人和残障人士提供服务的雇主机构中，有大量且持续增长的机构属于BLS统计框架范围，但未被纳入人口普查局框架；其二，许多企业在BLS框架中显示的机构数量显著更多。这些差异对测度的机构规模分布及量化政策分析产生了实质性影响。

title: Equilibrium with Internal Transfers
title_zh: 主要发达国家科技领域监管创新战略分析研究
title_primary: 主要发达国家科技领域监管创新战略分析研究
title_secondary: Equilibrium with Internal Transfers
authors: Liu, Mingyang, Farina, Gabriele, Ozdaglar, Asuman
official: 官方在线 2026-06-21 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Nash equilibrium (NE) arises from selfish utility maximization, yet its social welfare can be arbitrarily far from optimal. Moreover, computing an NE is intractable in general. We study augmented game models in which players use budget-balanced internal transfers to improve incentives before play. We first introduce \emph{Self-Enforcing Transfer Equilibrium} (SETE), where players commit to nonnegative peer-to-peer transfers that are paid only if the recipient does not deviate from a prescribed strategy. For polymatrix games, we show that every stationary point of the social welfare function, in particular any socially optimal strategy profile, can be sustained as a SETE. This induces a Nash equilibrium in the agent normal form of the corresponding augmented game. We further propose a polynomial-time algorithm and a decentralized learning dynamic to compute such product-form equilibria. We then introduce \emph{Mediated Self-Enforcing Transfer Equilibrium} (M-SETE), where a mediator makes both the payment schedule and the prescribed strategies binding offers. This additional enforcement resolves the agent-normal-form limitation: an M-SETE is a Nash equilibrium of the augmented game itself, not merely of its agent normal form, and any socially optimal strategy profile can be supported as an M-SETE in any finite game while preserving budget balance. Thus, internal transfers improve welfare and computation while preserving independent play on the equilibrium path. When full sequential-game stability is required, binding mediation provides the corresponding implementation.
abstract_zh: 国际投资者如何根据生物多样性风险调整投资组合？利用投资基金的月度组合数据，我们发现2021年《昆明宣言》促使基金经理将投资组合从高生物多样性风险国家重新配置至风险较低的国家，而最终基金投资者对此并未作出反应。基金经理减少了极端高生物多样性风险的敞口，但并未将低生物多样性风险视为盈利机会，从而将生物多样性定性为下行风险因素。投资基金会引发跨国溢出效应，因为这种重新配置触发了显著的资本流动，使同一地理区域内但基金所在国以外的国家受益。

title: A Multivariate distribution with Pareto tails and Pareto maxima
title_zh: 具有帕累托尾部与帕累托最大值的多元分布
title_primary: 具有帕累托尾部与帕累托最大值的多元分布
title_secondary: A Multivariate distribution with Pareto tails and Pareto maxima
authors: Costas Arkolakis, Andrés Rodríguez-Clare, Jiun-Hua Su
official: 官方在线 2026-06-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We present a new multivariate distribution with Pareto distributed tails and maxima. Compared to uncorrelated univariate Pareto distributions, it features one additional parameter that governs the covariance of its realizations. We argue that it has a number of aggregation properties that make it useful for applied work alongside multivariate Gumbel and Fréchet distributions. In particular, it is well suited for applications with a participation threshold. Finally, we show that this distribution is indeed valid by proving a general result about n-increasing functions.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一种新的多元分布，其尾部及最大值服从帕累托分布。与不相关的单变量帕累托分布相比，它增加了一个参数，用于控制其实现值的协方差。我们认为，该分布具有若干聚合性质，使其在应用工作中与多元Gumbel和Fréchet分布同样有用。特别是，它非常适合具有参与门槛的应用场景。最后，我们通过证明关于n递增函数的一般性结果，表明该分布确实是有效的。

title: From Meat to Plant‐Based Products? The Enduring Impact of BSE on Beef Consumption
title_zh: 从肉类到植物基产品？疯牛病对牛肉消费的持久影响
title_primary: 从肉类到植物基产品？疯牛病对牛肉消费的持久影响
title_secondary: From Meat to Plant‐Based Products? The Enduring Impact of BSE on Beef Consumption
authors: Jader Velásquez, Shon Ferguson
official: 官方在线 2026-06-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study reassesses the impact of the historical BSE outbreak on EU diets, showing that consumption patterns shifted persistently even after policy actions eliminated the food safety risk. Utilizing advanced difference‐in‐differences techniques on 1980–2020 data, we demonstrate that while beef consumption exhibited a transient U‐shaped recovery relative to other meats, it declined sharply compared to plant‐based products, with average reductions of 79%, 29%, and 28% for pulses, cereals, and vegetable oils, respectively. This highlights a structural dietary change, overlooked by previous analyses focused on meat substitution. Results are robust to sensitivity analyses. Understanding the primary drivers behind the structural shift in EU consumer diets over recent decades is crucial for future research investigating the reduction in red meat consumption driven by environmental and health concerns in high‐income countries.
abstract_zh: 本研究重新评估了历史上疯牛病疫情对欧盟饮食结构的影响，结果表明即使在政策行动消除食品安全风险后，消费模式仍发生了持续性转变。基于1980-2020年数据，采用先进的双重差分技术，我们发现：牛肉消费相对于其他肉类呈现短暂的U型恢复，但相较于植物性产品则显著下降——豆类、谷物和植物油的消费量平均分别减少79%、29%和28%。这揭示了以往聚焦肉类替代效应的研究所忽视的结构性饮食变迁。敏感性分析证实了结果的稳健性。理解近几十年来欧盟消费者饮食结构变迁的主要驱动力，对于未来研究高收入国家因环境和健康担忧导致红肉消费减少的课题具有关键意义。

title: Who benefits from capacity reduction programs? Insights from the U.S. Pacific Coast groundfish fishery
title_zh: 谁从产能削减计划中受益？来自美国太平洋沿岸底栖鱼类渔业的启示
title_primary: 谁从产能削减计划中受益？来自美国太平洋沿岸底栖鱼类渔业的启示
title_secondary: Who benefits from capacity reduction programs? Insights from the U.S. Pacific Coast groundfish fishery
authors: Frederik Strabo, Matthew N. Reimer, James N. Sanchirico
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Overextraction and excess capacity are longstanding challenges in natural resource industries. Capacity-reduction programs are increasingly common policy responses designed to reduce capacity, reallocate access rights, and improve environmental and economic outcomes. Yet little is known about how such programs distribute benefits and costs among participants who remain in the industry. This paper estimates the benefits accruing from the U.S. Pacific Coast Groundfish Buyback Program, which retired over one-third of its vessel capacity through a voluntary $46 million reverse auction. Exploiting spatial variation in capacity reductions across ports within a difference-in-differences design, we find that active vessels operating in ports with larger relative reductions realized substantial revenue gains, while those elsewhere saw small or negligible gains. Conservative estimates suggest the program generated approximately $23.9 million in additional revenues net of variable costs and program fees over the first seven years, yielding approximately $4.66 in private net benefits per dollar of fees paid during this period. However, returns varied widely depending on the degree of local capacity reduction. These findings demonstrate that while capacity reduction programs can yield significant economic gains for remaining industry participants, their uneven impacts raise important questions about program design and the balance between efficiency and equity.
abstract_zh: 过度捕捞与产能过剩是自然资源行业长期面临的挑战。产能削减计划作为一种日益普遍的政策应对措施，旨在减少产能、重新分配准入权，并改善环境与经济成效。然而，关于此类计划如何在继续留在行业内的参与者之间分配收益与成本，目前知之甚少。本文估算了美国太平洋沿岸底栖鱼类回购计划所带来的收益，该计划通过一场自愿性的4600万美元反向拍卖，淘汰了超过三分之一的渔船产能。利用双重差分设计中各港口产能削减的空间差异，我们发现，在产能相对削减幅度较大的港口运营的活跃渔船获得了显著的收入增长，而其他港口的渔船则仅获得微小或可忽略不计的收益。保守估计显示，该计划在头七年内产生了约2390万美元的额外收入（扣除可变成本与计划费用后），在此期间每支付1美元费用约带来4.66美元的私人净收益。然而，收益因当地产能削减程度的不同而差异显著。这些研究结果表明，尽管产能削减计划能为剩余行业参与者带来可观的经济收益，但其不均衡的影响引发了关于计划设计以及效率与公平之间平衡的重要问题。

title: Spatio-temporal analysis of vegetation cover transitions and underlying governance approaches in Malawi, Southern Africa
title_zh: 马拉维南部非洲植被覆盖变化及其治理方式的时空分析
title_primary: 马拉维南部非洲植被覆盖变化及其治理方式的时空分析
title_secondary: Spatio-temporal analysis of vegetation cover transitions and underlying governance approaches in Malawi, Southern Africa
authors: Ida Nadia S. Djenontin, Dan Wanyama, Leo C. Zulu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Forest-based solutions, such as forest landscape restoration (FLR), are increasingly emphasized in response to the interrelated crises of deforestation, biodiversity loss, and climate change. However, there is notable lack of attention to the relationship between forest governance approaches and forest transitions. In many African countries, little is known about how various forest governance models affect changes in vegetation cover over time. Leveraging remote sensing techniques and time-series analysis, we examine the changing patterns of vegetation cover from 2003 to 2021 across Malawi, where distinct governance approaches have been implemented within and across protected areas and communal lands. The analysis revealed varying patterns and magnitudes of greening (vegetation gain) and browning (vegetation loss) across different periods, seasons, locations, and scales. Our findings indicate a significant increase in greenness during 2003–2009 in districts where community-based forest management (CBFM) programs were implemented. Conversely, the extent of vegetation greening was mixed during 2005–2014 in areas where combined CBFM and forest co-management (FCoM) were the primary participatory forest governance models implemented. The FCoM governance model implemented solely during 2014–2019 was associated with very little vegetation greening. Our study offers insights into vegetation cover changes over specific timeframes, with a deeper understanding of how different participatory forest governance models have influenced these transitions. Specifically, our evidence demonstrates a positive association of CBFM with improvements in vegetation cover. This underscores the importance of strongly centering local communities in the implementation and monitoring processes of forest-based solutions, with increased power devolution, empowered self-governance authority, and stronger resource ownership rights. Consequently, an effective implementation of Malawi's FLR strategy should prioritize institutional models that fully devolve power to local community with adequate means for self-governance while granting secure resource rights. However, additional factors that would sustain observed greening outcomes require further investigation using modeling approaches.
abstract_zh: 基于森林的解决方案，如森林景观恢复（FLR），正日益受到重视，以应对森林砍伐、生物多样性丧失和气候变化这三重相互关联的危机。然而，森林治理方法与森林转型之间的关系却明显缺乏关注。在许多非洲国家，不同森林治理模式如何影响植被覆盖随时间的变化，人们知之甚少。利用遥感技术和时间序列分析，我们考察了2003年至2021年间马拉维植被覆盖的变化模式，该国在保护区和社区土地内外实施了不同的治理方法。分析揭示了不同时期、季节、地点和尺度上绿化（植被增加）和褐化（植被减少）的不同模式和程度。我们的研究结果表明，在实施社区森林管理（CBFM）项目的地区，2003年至2009年间绿度显著增加。相反，在2005年至2014年间，以CBFM和森林共同管理（FCoM）为主要参与式森林治理模式的地区，植被绿化的程度参差不齐。仅在2014年至2019年间实施的FCoM治理模式与极少的植被绿化相关。我们的研究提供了特定时间框架内植被覆盖变化的见解，并深入理解了不同参与式森林治理模式如何影响这些转型。具体而言，我们的证据表明CBFM与植被覆盖改善之间存在正相关关系。这强调了在森林解决方案的实施和监测过程中，以地方社区为核心的重要性，包括增加权力下放、增强自治权以及强化资源所有权。因此，有效实施马拉维的FLR战略应优先考虑将权力完全下放给地方社区、提供充分自治手段并保障资源权利的体制模式。然而，维持所观察到的绿化成果的其他因素仍需通过建模方法进一步研究。

title: Extreme justifications fuel polarisation
title_zh: 极端理由加剧极化
title_primary: 极端理由加剧极化
title_secondary: Extreme justifications fuel polarisation
authors: Christiane Buschinger, Markus Eyting, Florian Hett, Judd Kessler
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: How does polarisation — as measured by mistreatment of political rivals — spread? In an online experiment, participants choose between splitting financial resources equally or discriminating against a supporter of the opposing political party. We vary the information subjects receive about others’ choices and justifications for discrimination. Exposure to extreme justifications for discrimination increases discrimination — particularly in a polarized environment, when many others are already discriminating — and it leads participants to adopt more extreme justifications themselves. Our findings suggest a self-reinforcing dynamic that may fuel polarisation: Exposure to extreme statements increases polarisation and the prevalence of extreme reasoning.
abstract_zh: 极化——以政治对手遭受不公对待为衡量标准——是如何扩散的？在一项在线实验中，参与者在平均分配财务资源与歧视对立政党支持者之间做出选择。我们调整了受试者接收到的关于他人选择及歧视理由的信息。接触极端的歧视理由会增加歧视行为——尤其是在极化环境中，当许多人已经实施歧视时——并且会导致参与者自身采用更极端的理由。我们的研究结果表明，一种可能加剧极化的自我强化动态：接触极端言论会加剧极化，并增加极端推理的普遍性。

title: Early-term abortion bans and sex selection after Dobbs v Jackson
title_zh: 多布斯诉杰克逊案后的早期堕胎禁令与性别选择
title_primary: 多布斯诉杰克逊案后的早期堕胎禁令与性别选择
title_secondary: Early-term abortion bans and sex selection after Dobbs v Jackson
authors: Xin Brown, William Jergins
official: 官方在线 2026-05-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Following the 2022 US Supreme Court decision Dobbs v Jackson, many states adopted early-term abortion (ETA) bans that prohibit abortions before the age of viability and often before sex determination is technologically feasible. We analyze the effect of ETA bans on the sex ratio at birth among first-generation Chinese, Korean, and Indian (CKI) immigrants using difference-in-differences and triple differences methodologies. While our estimates across higher parity children sometimes indicate a decrease in the sex ratio at birth, they are also generally small and statistically insignificant, which is consistent with continued access to sex selection under ETA bans. In contrast, we find that ETA bans are associated with a large and statistically significant increase in the sex ratio at birth among first-parity children to immigrant CKI women. As elevated sex ratios have not been previously documented on first-parity children, this may indicate that ETA bans shift sex-selective behavior to earlier parities by placing additional emphasis on having a boy now, before any further restrictions on abortions occur. Our estimates suggest that ETA bans caused 139 missing, first-born girls in 2023 alone.
abstract_zh: 2022年美国最高法院对多布斯诉杰克逊案作出裁决后，许多州通过了早期堕胎禁令，禁止在胎儿存活期之前（且通常在技术无法确定胎儿性别之前）实施堕胎。我们采用双重差分法和三重差分法，分析了早期堕胎禁令对第一代华裔、韩裔和印度裔移民出生性别比的影响。尽管对较高胎次子女的估算有时显示出生性别比下降，但这些结果普遍较小且统计上不显著，这与早期堕胎禁令下仍可继续实施性别选择的情况一致。相反，我们发现早期堕胎禁令与移民华裔、韩裔和印度裔女性第一胎子女的出生性别比大幅且统计上显著上升相关。由于此前未发现第一胎子女存在性别比偏高现象，这可能表明早期堕胎禁令通过强调在进一步堕胎限制实施前优先生育男孩，将性别选择行为提前至更早胎次。我们的估算显示，仅2023年，早期堕胎禁令就导致139名第一胎女婴缺失。

title: Short- and Long-Term Effects of Universal Preschool: Evidence from the Arab Population in Israel
title_zh: 以色列阿拉伯人口中普及学前教育的短期与长期效应
title_primary: 以色列阿拉伯人口中普及学前教育的短期与长期效应
title_secondary: Short- and Long-Term Effects of Universal Preschool: Evidence from the Arab Population in Israel
authors: Elad DeMalach, Analia Schlosser
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We estimate the causal impacts of universal preschool by leveraging a quasi-experimental design based on Israel’s implementation of free public preschool for children ages 3 and 4 beginning in September 1999. We focus on the Arab population, who were the main beneficiaries of the first phase of the law’s implementation. Using a difference-in-differences (DID) research design, we find that universal preschool enhanced individuals’ academic performance from elementary school through high school, improved the learning environment, and increased postsecondary enrollment. Additional benefits include reduced juvenile delinquency among males and decreased early marriage among females. (JEL I21, I24, I28, J15, J16)
abstract_zh: 我们利用以色列自1999年9月起对3至4岁儿童实施免费公立学前教育的准实验设计，评估了普及型学前教育的因果影响。研究聚焦于该法律第一阶段的主要受益群体——阿拉伯人口。通过双重差分（DID）研究设计，我们发现普及型学前教育提升了个人从小学到高中的学业表现，改善了学习环境，并提高了高等教育入学率。其他益处包括降低男性青少年犯罪率和减少女性早婚现象。（JEL I21, I24, I28, J15, J16）

title: Trade openness, global value chain integration and firms’ adoption of environment-friendly strategies
title_zh: 贸易开放、全球价值链整合与企业环境友好型战略的采纳
title_primary: 贸易开放、全球价值链整合与企业环境友好型战略的采纳
title_secondary: Trade openness, global value chain integration and firms’ adoption of environment-friendly strategies
authors: Isabel Maria Bodas Freitas, Fulvio Castellacci, Keun Lee, Matthias Staessens
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-05-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper investigates whether firms that are more open to international trade engage more extensively in efforts to reduce the environmental impact of their activities by adopting environment-friendly strategies (i.e., implementing new practices and technologies that reduce pollution and resource use). In particular, we examine the direction of this relationship for different levels of industry integration in Global Value Chains (GVCs) and different degrees of GVC trade partners’ environmental performance. Our econometric analysis uses data from 4,886 manufacturing firms from 21 lower and upper middle-income countries in Central Asia, Eastern Europe and the Middle East and North Africa. The results suggest a positive association between firm openness to international markets and intensity of use of environmentally friendly practices and technologies. This relationship becomes stronger for higher levels of environmental performance by industry GVC partners and weaker levels of industry integration in GVC.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了那些对国际贸易更为开放的企业，是否会更积极地采取环保策略（即实施减少污染和资源使用的新实践与技术）以降低其活动对环境的影响。具体而言，我们考察了在不同行业全球价值链（GVC）整合水平及不同GVC贸易伙伴环境绩效程度下，这一关系的方向性。我们的计量分析使用了来自中亚、东欧以及中东和北非地区21个中低收入和中等偏上收入国家的4，886家制造业企业的数据。结果表明，企业对国际市场的开放程度与环保实践和技术的使用强度之间存在正相关关系。当行业GVC伙伴的环境绩效较高时，这种关系更为显著；而当行业在GVC中的整合程度较低时，这种关系则较弱。

title: Incentive and Signaling Effects of Bonus Payments: An Experiment in a Company
title_zh: 奖金支付的激励与信号效应：一项公司实验
title_primary: 奖金支付的激励与信号效应：一项公司实验
title_secondary: Incentive and Signaling Effects of Bonus Payments: An Experiment in a Company
authors: Marvin Deversi, Lisa Spantig
official: 官方在线 2026-03-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Economists and management scholars have argued that the scope of incentives to increase cooperation in organizations is limited as their use may signal the prevalence of free-riding among employees. This paper tests this hypothesis with an artefactual field experiment that assigns managers and employees from a large company to stylized roles within a controlled game. We exogenously vary whether managers are informed about prevailing cooperation levels among employees before they can set incentives to promote cooperation. In addition, employees matched to informed managers learn that the manager could base their incentive choice on cooperation levels. We find no evidence for the hypothesized signaling effect. Having an informed manager set the incentive does not change employees' beliefs about the cooperativeness of others. Incentives, hence, have strong positive effects on cooperative beliefs, irrespective of information. The absence of the signaling effect appears to reflect employees' perceptions of managerial intentions: incentives are interpreted not as signals of low cooperation, but as rewards for expected cooperation. A follow-up survey experiment supports this mechanism, showing that a cooperative culture affects the interpretation of managerial actions.
abstract_zh: 经济学家和管理学者认为，在组织中通过激励手段促进合作的范畴有限，因为采用此类激励可能向员工传递出搭便车行为普遍存在的信号。本文通过一项人工实地实验来检验这一假设，该实验将一家大型企业的经理与员工分配至受控游戏中的设定角色。我们外生地变化经理在设定激励以促进合作前是否知晓员工当前的合作水平。此外，与知情经理匹配的员工会得知经理可能依据合作水平来决定激励措施。我们未发现支持该假设性信号效应的证据。由知情经理设定激励并未改变员工对他人合作性的信念。因此，无论信息状况如何，激励对合作信念均产生强烈的正向影响。信号效应的缺失似乎反映了员工对管理意图的感知：激励并非被视为低合作水平的信号，而是被理解为对预期合作的奖励。一项后续调查实验支持了这一机制，表明合作文化会影响对管理行为的解读。

title: More Competition, Better Products: Evidence From Tariff Cuts
title_zh: 更多竞争，更优产品：来自关税削减的证据
title_primary: 更多竞争，更优产品：来自关税削减的证据
title_secondary: More Competition, Better Products: Evidence From Tariff Cuts
authors: Colin Davison
official: 官方在线 2025-11-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article examines how increased competition affects product and process innovation. I combine plausibly exogenous variation in foreign competition induced by large tariff cuts with a difference‐in‐differences strategy and find that firms increase their product patenting in response to increased foreign competition, but, on average, foreign competition has no effect on process patenting. Firms operating in industries where patents are an effective means of protecting their competitive advantage increase their patenting more in response to competition. Initially large and productive firms engage in more process innovation in response to competitive pressure.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了竞争加剧如何影响产品创新与过程创新。我将关税大幅削减所引发的看似外生的外国竞争变化与双重差分策略相结合，发现企业会因外国竞争加剧而增加产品专利申请，但平均而言，外国竞争对过程专利申请没有影响。在专利能有效保护其竞争优势的行业中，企业会因竞争而更多地增加专利申请。初始规模较大且生产率较高的企业，在竞争压力下会更多地参与过程创新。
